status: Fixed locally before these runs, after inspecting step-3 results; not an external preregistration or an independent confirmatory sample.
purpose: Test whether WSR has an aggregate-delay advantage over group repair under matched individual ground-delay protection; do not assume such an advantage.

search.objective: Fixed 3/2/1 weighted ground delay; strict group improvement
search.low_level: Same earliest-departure, structural-cost, duration and canonical tie order as the preserved step-3 LNS-R

modes.free: LNS-U: no individual bound beyond the common domain
modes.initial: LNS-I: every accepted allocation satisfies d_i <= d_i(SPC); intermediate reversals below this bound are allowed
modes.monotone: LNS-M: every accepted group update satisfies d_i(new) <= d_i(current) for every selected flight

search.timing: Sequential, one requested numerical-library thread; include template construction, SPC initialization and tracing in total solver time. Exclude trajectory audits and disk IO. Rotate main-mode execution order by seed. No concurrent tests or PDF rendering during formal timing.
search.acceptance: Strict weighted group improvement; all replacements checked before commit; complete rollback after failure, rejection or time limit

comparators: Preserved WSR and SPC records, matched by exact scenario/model hashes and reconstructed initial allocation. The 30 fresh LNS-U runs control the implementation and execution period for the main protection ablation; preserve previous LNS-R records separately. Large-network unrestricted comparison uses the explicitly historical step-3 LNS-R records.
reporting: All prescribed cases including failures; paired seed means and improved/tied/worse counts; final violations of SPC caps; accepted-update reversals; total and weighted delay; full total runtime and anytime value at each historical WSR completion time. Also compare modes at their common completed-iteration prefix to separate iteration count from wall-clock stopping. No new p-values, no tuning on formal seeds, no inference that LNS-I/LNS-M dominate every protected algorithm.
operational_scope: A declared latest-entry commitment before dispatch; early entry, route/layer/speed revision and deterministic known demand must be permissible. No claim that contracts were observed or that UAV regulations universally prohibit postponement. Ground delay only; no arrival/energy/path-stability protection.
verification: Test cap enforcement against exhaustive grid enumeration, rollback and legacy unrestricted equivalence. Save every accepted replacement; reconstruct final and accepted schedules, verify trace, caps, objective, candidates, resource feasibility, and final 0.25 s sampled separation. Shared geometry remains a limitation.
